options.content:
## Kukule Ganga - release & generation plan
**Change any value in the bar above and every panel re-runs the model.** *Starting storage*, *inflow vs forecast* (wet/dry), *demand vs forecast*, *units available* and the *method* are the inputs. *Source = Live files* plans from the daily-runner inbox (`data/live_inputs`).  
_Modelled study dataset (not observed CEB telemetry) - decision support only._

panels.title: Turbine release today
panels.description: Recommended turbine discharge for day 1 of the plan.

panels.title: Generation today
panels.description: Expected energy for day 1 (station maximum 1,680 MWh/day).

panels.title: Storage at end of day
panels.description: Active storage after day 1. Red < 20% reserve, amber < 50% year-end target, green otherwise.

panels.title: Pond level
panels.description: Pond level after day 1. Hard floor 204.00 masl, full supply level 206.00 masl.

panels.title: Mandatory river release
panels.description: Environmental flow (2 m3/s) plus the seasonal irrigation release; served first, never counted as spill.

panels.title: Alert status
panels.description: OK = no warnings; WATCH = flood risk or plan ends below target; ALERT = reserve or river-release shortfall.

panels.title: What the model is warning about
Lowest storage in the plan
panels.description: Never below the 20% operating reserve unless the river release forces it.

panels.title: Hard-floor breaches (204.00 masl)
panels.description: Must be 0: the safety layer never lets the pond go below the floor.

panels.title: Turbine release vs forecast inflow (m3/s)
panels.description: The plan releases water through the turbines and always keeps the river release. The dashed line is the median inflow forecast (the P90 flood risk is summarised by the alert status).

panels.title: Storage vs reserve and year-end target (%)
panels.description: Active storage after each day. It should stay above the reserve line and finish near the target.

panels.title: Daily generation (MWh) and demand weight
panels.description: Energy is worth more on high-demand days (weight > 1: festivals, weekdays). The plan shifts water towards them within the pond's limits.

panels.title: Pond level (masl) vs hard floor and full supply level
panels.description: Pond water level after each day.

panels.title: Day-1 turbine release by method (m3/s)
panels.description: What each method would release today.

panels.title: Energy over the 15-day plan (MWh)
panels.description: Energy differs by only a few percent between methods; the differences that matter are storage and safety.

panels.title: Storage at end of the plan (%)
panels.description: Year-end target is 50%. The reference rule drains the pond to the reserve.

panels.title: Safety and efficiency check by method
panels.description: Every method runs through the same safety layer: floor breaches must be 0.

panels.title: 15-day schedule (selected method)
panels.description: The exact numbers behind the charts.

panels.title: Input files
panels.description: Validation of data/live_inputs (forecasts + state.json).

panels.title: Minutes since last plan
panels.description: Time since the daily runner last produced a plan.

panels.title: Inputs rejected
panels.description: Bad or stale input files are rejected (and logged) instead of being used.

panels.title: Accepted plans: recommended release and expected storage (one group per plan)
panels.description: One group of bars per daily-runner check (outputs/live/decision_log.csv); rejected inputs have no bars.

panels.title: Decision log (newest first)
panels.description: PLANNED = accepted inputs and a new plan; REJECTED = bad or stale input (reason shown); previous plan stays valid.
